summary: Payette NF log cabin built 1937 (one listing says 1936), inactive from 1945, burned in a 2015 forest fire; site lies in the Frank Church wilderness.

facts.design: Log cabin with dovetailed corners, built with hand tools from logs gathered on site
facts.status_note: Burned in a forest fire in the summer of 2015

visit.trail_note: Hike-in site inside the Frank Church River of No Return Wilderness

corrections.why: The register says the lookout burned during the summer of 2015; the event should name the fire

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 1937; firelookout.com gives 1936. The story gives the register's year and notes the other.
firelookout.com says abandoned in 1952; Idaho Fire Lookouts puts abandonment in the 1960s, and the register dates only the window removal to the 1960s. The story reports both.
Register gives 6,821 ft (2,079 m); firelookout.com gives 8,360 ft; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 7,056 ft. The record keeps the register figure.

notes_for_editor: The 2015 fire and the wilderness location agree across all three sources. Build year (1936 or 1937) and abandonment (1952 or 1960s) conflict. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history. No source describes the site after the fire in text; the register and firelookout.com carry photos with captions only, so none was added as a new find. The brief's access 'unknown' was left unset, because no source states an access rule.
